The most plausible structure is 4,4'-dipropoxy‑biphenyl, which fits the symmetry (each aromatic carbon appears twice) and the aliphatic carbon signals (O‑CH2, CH2, CH3). Its SMILES is "CCCOc1ccc(cc1)C(c2ccc(OCCC)cc2)".</thought>
<final_answer>CCCOc1ccc(cc1)C(c2ccc(OCCC)cc2)</final_answer>
